sourceKeySloStatus: teacher-provided item B-40/B-44 reference retained as provenance, NOT independent board-verified item mapping
sourceKeyCognitiveStatus: teacher-provided K/U/A labels retained as provenance, NOT individually board-certified cognitive classification
sourceScope: Topic6.6 applications of Bernoulli and continuity: atomizer, water-jet filter pump, Torricelli efflux, Venturi meter, carburetor, aerofoil lift, Magnus effect and paper-sheets demonstration. Twenty numeric MCQs and twenty standalone situations.
limitations: All 80 original source question stems, printed A-D options and teacher-key answer letters preserved; PDF line breaks normalized and split key explanations rejoined.
Q2 refers to Figure6.10, Q13 to Figure6.13 and Q16 to simplified aerofoil diagram; each is text-answerable without inspecting the figure, so no figure hold introduced.
All 20 Section IV situations are independent MCQs, not 4-question common-stimulus groups.
Printed key B-40/B-44 and K/U/A item tags are teacher source annotations, not independently confirmed official per-item mappings; P-11-B-39 is formative context.
The textbook's aerofoil explanation and numeric wing lift are idealized Bernoulli model examples; real lift depends on the full flow field; equal-transit-time is not a physical requirement.
This is standalone public self-practice only. V85 central bank stays 2,084 items (394 partial Unit6), full Unit6 planned and no cloud grades.
